message: Press ONE AT A TIME, about 4 seconds apart, in THIS order: 1) RT pulled FULLY to the end stop, hold 1s, release   2) Capture/Share   3) Xbox/Guide button (centre)   4) EACH rear/extra M button you have, in order M1, M2, M3, M4, M5, M6, M7 (skip any that do not exist). Then reply DONE in Hermes.

message: Mop-up, ONE AT A TIME ~4 s apart: 1) RT - squeeze it slowly and firmly to the end stop, hold 2 seconds   2) M5   3) M6   4) M7   (skip any M button your unit does not have). If you have any other button I have not asked about yet (e.g. a Turbo or profile button), press it last. Then reply DONE in Hermes.
